settings.heading: How to apply
settings.body: Clean and dry the bridge of your nose. Peel the liner, centre the strip just above the flare of your nostrils, press the ends for five seconds. Remove under warm water.

settings.heading: Four reasons it stays in your gym bag

settings.title: Clean & dry
settings.body: Wash and dry the bridge of your nose so the adhesive grips properly.

settings.title: Peel & place
settings.body: Remove the liner and centre the strip just above the flare of your nostrils.

settings.title: Press & hold
settings.body: Press the ends down for five seconds. The spring bands do the rest.

settings.title: Breathe
settings.body: Train, race or sleep. Peel off gently under warm water.

settings.question: Will it stay on while I train?
settings.answer: Yes — sweat-resistant medical-grade adhesive rated for up to 10 hours, including humid conditions. Apply to clean, dry skin.

settings.question: Does it help with snoring?
settings.answer: It helps when snoring is driven by nasal congestion or a narrow nasal valve. It is not a treatment for sleep apnoea — speak to a doctor if you suspect that.

settings.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
settings.answer: Tell us within 30 nights and we'll refund you. You don't need to send the pack back.
